text:
Raya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the outage. RCA: https://redwood.company/rca/INC-2026-042. Using this thread to capture owners, one-line ETAs, and leadership Qs (SLO impact, Dedicated mitigations, and the 7-day watch). Keep replies short. :spiral_notepad:

Colin: I'll own the rollback playbook + canary scripts. ETA: 2026-03-28 07:00 UTC. I'll add steps to `ops/playbooks/kv-rollback.md` and include the canary verification.

Sofia: I'll update the oncall runbook, add the new detection thresholds, and include a verification checklist. ETA: 2026-03-28 13:00 UTC.

Mateo: I can draft a customer note for Hosted+Dedi and coordinate Legal/PR signoff. Draft 1 by 2026-03-28 18:00 UTC. Tagging Support for impacted-customer list.

LegalBot: Noted: Legal review required for customer comms. Please ping @Legal when draft is posted.

Raya: Leadership asked two concrete things: (1) Are we changing public SLOs? (2) Will we provision temporary Dedicated capacity for high-risk customers? Also need a 2-line ops blurb for next all-hands slide.

Colin: No SLO changes today. If rollback doesn't restore baseline within 72h we'll propose a narrow guardrail tweak.

Mateo: Ops can provision a 48h Dedicated buffer for top-tier accounts pending Ops lead approval. I'll prepare the approval packet once we have the account list.

Sofia: Platform Reliability will run the 7-day elevated watch; I'll post a daily 1-line snapshot here at 09:00 UTC and attach the dashboard link.

Colin: Rollback verification commands (to include in playbook):
```
# restart cache proxy and check primary metrics
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy
curl -sS http://internal-metrics/kv | jq .kv_hit_rate
# simple load check
wrk -t2 -c40 -d10s http://internal-loadtest/priming
```

Sofia: Proposed alert expression for Prometheus: `increase(kv_stall_total[3m]) / increase(kv_req_total[3m]) > 0.015`. I'll add a Grafana panel and link it in the runbook.

Mateo: Draft comms will default to plain language with link to RCA + guided next steps. Posting draft here when ready and will tag @Legal and @PR.

Raya: Please paste final links here when done. One leadership ask: drop a 1-2 line "ops change" blurb by EOD tomorrow. I'll assemble the consolidated action tracker and schedule a 48h sync.

Colin: Blurb: "Rolled back a KV cache change, tightened detection thresholds, and instituted a 7-day elevated monitoring window with temporary Dedicated capacity options for critical accounts."

Sofia: Runbook + alert updated: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/kv-oncall (will append verification checklist).

SupportBot: Created follow-up task INC-2026-042-ACTIONS and assigned Colin/Sofia/Mateo. Link: https://redwood.company/tasks/INC-2026-042-ACTIONS. Next check-in 2026-03-29 09:00 UTC.

Raya: Thanks all. Closing thread for new topics; append links only so I can export the tracker. :white_check_mark:
